item.title: Git tips
item.description: How to get the changes on a branch in Git # Changes on branch but not on HEAD (three dots) git diff HEAD...branch # List recent branches and switch $ git checkout $(git for-each-ref --sort='-authordate:iso8601' --format=' %(authordate:relative)%09%(refname:short)' refs | pick | cut -f2) # .gitconfig alias [alias] branches = "!sh -c \"git checkout $(git for-each-ref --sort='-authordate:iso8601' --format=' %(authordate:relative)%09%(refname:short)' refs | pick | cut -f2)\"" Source. Uses pick. See branches merged into other branch git branch --merged master # lists branches merged into master git branch --merged # lists branches merged into HEAD (i.
